title: Dynamic memory: a growable vector
hints: When len == cap, grow: size_t new_cap = cap ? cap * 2 : 4; int *p = realloc(v->data, new_cap * sizeof *p); check p != nullptr before overwriting v->data.
vec_free: free(v->data); then reset the struct to {0} so a double free is harmless. ASan will flag any write past the end.
